items:
Only a five-minute stroll to the beautiful white beaches of the Gulf, Palm Breeze is pristine perfect for groups looking to relax and connect. Nestled in a charming Inlet Beach neighborhood, it’s close to shopping and dining. Just a stroll or quick bike ride to Rosemary Beach. With three bedrooms, two and a half baths, and space for up to eight guests, it’s ideal for families or friends. Includes a beach cart, four chairs, and an umbrella for fun-filled days on the Florida coast's beautiful white sand beaches.

Your space!

Palm Breeze at Inlet Beach's prime location, with its myriad of recreational activities, truly distinguishes it from others. This well-designed spacious open floor plan allows your group to feel connected as they gather around the 8-person dining table. The fully-equipped kitchen, complete with contemporary appliances, including both Keurig and classic coffee makers, ensures your effortless meal preparation.

The beach is within a quick five-minute walk, offers public restrooms, bike racks, and outdoor showers. Quick walk to Rosemary Beach.

Other things to note
The backyard is not fully fenced in. It does have a fence on three sides.

No pets of any kind allowed.

Palm Breeze at Inlet Beach is a pet-free home. If any breed of animal, large or small, is found to have been at the home, an additional cleaning fee of $1150 will be charged for deep cleaning and replacement of all bedding and rugs.

Any person over the allowed eight-person maximum occupancy will be charged $55 per person per day. Primary guest (reservation holder) assumes responsibility for any and all damages to the property from all family members and guests.

The primary guest who booked must be on property accompanying all guests for the duration of your stay.

No smoking, vaping or burning of any substance inside the home.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

description: Located in Panama City Beach, this vacation home is near a water park and by the sea. The area's natural beauty can be seen at Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach, while Frank Brown Park and Shipwreck Island Waterpark are popular area attractions. Emerald Coast Mirror Maze and SkyWheel are also worth visiting. Discover the area's water adventures with jet skiing and kayaking nearby, or enjoy the great outdoors with horse riding and cycling.

reviews.author: Charles P.
reviews.label: Excellent
reviews.text: We had an absolutely wonderful time at this property! From the moment we arrived, everything exceeded our expectations. The house was spotless, beautifully decorated, and fully equipped with everything we needed (and more). The kitchen had all the essentials for cooking, the beds were incredibly comfortable, and the outdoor space was even better than the photos — perfect for relaxing and enjoying the view.The location was ideal: peaceful and private, yet close enough to shops, restaurants, and attractions. The host was also fantastic — very responsive, kind, and made sure we felt at home.We truly didn’t want to leave and are already looking forward to coming back. If you’re considering this property, don’t hesitate — you won’t be disappointed

reviews.author: Michelle F.
reviews.label: Excellent
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our stay at Palm Breeze! When we arrived, the house was clean and just as shown in the pictures and was just the right amount of space for our group of four. The house was equipped with a beach cart with beach chairs and an umbrella, beach towels, and a cooler, which were all total game changers for our beach days. The beach was a short walk from the house and was beautiful. The water was crystal clear so we enjoyed swimming and looking at the fish and we even got lucky enough to encounter a sea turtle! What really stood out about our stay was the host, Chris. I had requests and questions for him from the time that I booked the house and he was always extremely responsive and happy to accommodate and help where he could. His attentiveness really elevated our experience, and we were extremely appreciative. We would definitely stay at Palm Breeze again!
